# Equipment schemas
{: .no_toc}

Type-specific details of equipment installed in a setup.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## How to use this family

- [`equipment`](/api/modules/equipment/): set `type` to a type code below and send its properties in `details`.
- Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Equipment/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Equipment/<Type>.json` is the current version and `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Equipment/<Type>/` lists the versions. See [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).
- Quantities are objects `{"value": <number>, "unit": "<code>"}`. Property paths with `[]` are inside a repeatable list of rows. The server sets the schema version field itself.

## Data acquisition

### Amplifier

- type code `Amplifier` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Equipment/Amplifier/1.0.0.json)

An amplifier unit installed in a setup that amplifies and filters electrophysiological signals before digitization. A recording station tracked as one unit is an Ephys rig.

This type has no type-specific properties: send an empty object. Everything meaningful is recorded on the record itself or on its material usage rows.

- `consumable` accepts Consumable types: [`OpticFiberDesign`](/api/schemas/consumable/#optic-fiber-design), [`SiliconProbeDesign`](/api/schemas/consumable/#silicon-probe-design), [`EcogArrayDesign`](/api/schemas/consumable/#ecog-array-design), [`SingleWireElectrode`](/api/schemas/consumable/#single-wire-electrode); the web form offers only these.
- `coordinates_system` accepts Coordinates types: [`External_XYZ_Euler`](/api/schemas/coordinates/#external-xyz-coordinates-with-euler-orientation), [`External_XYZ_Quaternion`](/api/schemas/coordinates/#external-xyz-coordinates-with-quaternion-orientation); other values are refused (400).
